content.short: Tada is a ride-hailing mini-app on TON allowing users to book taxis and pay with Toncoin and USDT.
content.description: Tada Mini is a groundbreaking real-world utility application built as a Telegram Mini App on the TON blockchain. It allows users, particularly in Southeast Asia, to book ride-hailing services directly through the Telegram interface. A key feature of Tada Mini is its seamless integration with TON wallets, enabling users to pay for their trips using Toncoin or USDT. By bridging the gap between blockchain technology and everyday services, Tada Mini demonstrates the practical benefits of the TON ecosystem, offering a fast, secure, and convenient transportation solution for millions of users.
